PF.43817/D.S.9.a. SECRET.

G.P.O. - Captain Booth.

I should be glad if you would kindly submit for the next fortnight the usual return of correspondence addressed to:-

17, Hurstwood Road,
N.W.11.

(♂) G.W.H.

22nd October, 1935.
